description:
-= Scullery =-
You find yourself in a scullery. An usual one.

You make out a type 9 chest. You make out a closed fridge nearby.

You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unblocked.
inventory: You are carrying: a type 9 passkey and a mat.
objective: You are now playing a life changing game of TextWorld! First of all, make it so that the type 9 chest in the scullery is unlocked. Then, ensure that the type 9 chest is open. That's it!
